reason: A is the better proposal because Ag segregation offers a plausible, falsifiable route to interfacial low-shear lubrication over a broader temperature range and is not merely a restatement of the cited work, although its composition and predicted effect need tighter specification. B largely repeats the cited nanoflake study and extrapolates an ethanol-derived amorphous-carbon film to ~600 °C in air, where carbon oxidation, organic-source depletion, and coating degradation make wide-temperature efficacy physically doubtful.
